name: proofread-mcp
description: Check US case citations against an open register of 10 million court opinions.
long_description: proofread.law checks every case citation in a draft against an open register of about 10 million US court opinions (CourtListener bulk data). Each row comes back as red (check this: the register holds something concrete that disagrees), orange (cannot verify: nothing to check against, such as a Westlaw or Lexis identifier), green (found) or, with the opt-in deep check, whether the opinion supports the sentence it is cited for. Every result carries the coverage statement. Nothing you submit is stored. Not covered: Westlaw/Lexis identifiers, statutes, regulations, secondary sources, whether a case is still good law.

tools.name: check_citations
tools.description: Check the case citations in a text; red, orange, green rows with the coverage statement

tools.name: check_document
tools.description: Check the case citations in a PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown file on disk

tools.name: resolve_citation
tools.description: Look up one citation in the register: which case, court, date, parallel citations, coverage

tools.name: resolve_citations
tools.description: Look up a list of up to 500 citations in one call

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: What the register holds and cannot check, and the storage notice

tools.name: render_report
tools.description: Render a finished check as a markdown diligence report
